answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 559 Country: United Kingdom Title: Can you please tell ne why in Hajj "Rami" is performed over three days while the incident between hadrat ibrahim/ismail only took place once. Also why on one day only one jamaraat is pelted only? Question: Assalamu alaykum Can you please tell ne why in Hajj "Rami" is performed over three days while the incident between hadrat ibrahim/ismail only took place once. Also why on one day only one jamaraat is pelted only? May Allah reward you in both worlds. Answer ID: 559 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 754=534/H) The story of Hazrat Ibrahim and Isamel (Alaihimas Salam) is a Sabab (cause) not Illah (Base) of the matter. Actually, the commandment of Shariah is the base of this ruling. And, the commandment is that on the first day Rami of one Jamara, on the second and third day Rami of three Jamaraat should be performed. Secondly, it is to be noted the activities of Hajj are manifestations of the love of Allah. And, in a lover?s styles no reasons are being applied. For people like us, it is enough that this is a commandment of Quran and Hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
